blocks.heading: Notes, snapshots, restore
blocks.body:
An **annotation** is a note stuck on the AEM page for a teammate. A **version** is a snapshot of the page. **Restore** puts an old snapshot back on author.

This is not Git. This is not Track Changes in Oxygen. If the landing page lives in AEM, leave the notes in AEM.

Take a version before a campaign swap. After a restore, check whether you still need to publish. Restore does not always mean live.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: The log says restore is Git, or annotations are DITA comments, or you mix three review tools on the same landing page.

Expected: Three verbs with menu names (or verify notes). One channel for the page. Mock labeled.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Read Experience League on annotations and page versions (authoring). Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week10/field-log-68.txt with the menu names you saw. If a label differs, write ‘verify in your version’.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Three verbs: annotate (leave a note on the page), version (take a snapshot), restore (put an old snapshot back).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write: this is not Git. This is not Oxygen Track Changes. If the landing page is in AEM, review it in AEM.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Kitepump: take a version before a campaign swap, not after a panic.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Write a question in the log: after restore, do I still need to publish? (Usually yes :  restore is on author.)

steps.body: Labeled mock: a list of versions. Caption: mock.

blocks.q: You restored a page version. Did that publish the page?
options: Not always :  restore is on the author side. You may still need to publish
Restore is the same as Publish
blocks.why: Author vs publish still applies. Restore puts the old page back on author.

blocks.q: Why take a version before you swap the teaser?
options: AEM requires a version every hour
Restore needs a snapshot. Panic has none
blocks.why: A snapshot is insurance on the author side.
